title: The record past 2 Nov 2026: the NOAA-20 bridge on Jan–Oct 2026
reading: Pass: from November 2026 Punjab's harmonised record continues on NOAA-20, converted by the primary bridge, in whole months only (no month mixes satellites). After October 2026 NOAA-20's files are near-real-time with no type field, so the primary bridge fitted without the type screen is used. The seam is drawn and labelled 'S-NPP ended 2 Nov 2026, 15:40 UTC (NOAA NESDIS Update #4)'. NOAA-21 appears only as its own labelled series, never summed. Other areas show NOAA-20 in its own units after S-NPP's end, labelled 'bridge tested in Punjab only'. M0 (no conversion) is reported beside the bridge: a pass shows that converted NOAA-20 tracks S-NPP within the marks, not that M1 beats no conversion.

seam_label: S-NPP ended 2 Nov 2026, 15:40 UTC (NOAA NESDIS Update #4)
approved: Hasnain, 8 Nov 2026: 'Run without it' - his answer to 'Run P04's tests before the checker's P04-CL report arrives?' (DECISIONS.md, commit 9833fdd; change log entry 2, commit 5a9a241)
streams: per month: SP if FIRMS's availability covers the whole month for both satellites, otherwise NRT for both
filters: quality rule (MODIS confidence >= 30; VIIRS confidence nominal or high (n/h)); type-0 screen only in months whose files carry a type field; geoBoundaries province polygons; day and night passes. 2026 rows: rows that pass c08.ingest.parse_frame's data contract, with exact duplicates removed (same platform, UTC time, latitude, longitude and version), from the FIRMS area-API download box recorded with each file (data/manifest.json, bbox) intersected with the province polygons. The bridge's training rows: FIRMS's Pakistan country file (standard stream, c08.ingest) intersected with the same province polygons. 'Pakistan' means all seven geoBoundaries ADM1 polygons (Azad Kashmir, Balochistan, Gilgit-Baltistan, Islamabad Capital Territory, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Punjab, Sindh).

rules.matched_days: neither satellite on either refreshed list, and each satellite has at least one row anywhere in Pakistan on its day pass and on its night pass that UTC day (every row, before the quality rule). 'Anywhere in Pakistan' means rows of the month's chosen stream (SP or NRT) that passed c08.ingest.parse_frame's data contract and fall inside a province polygon (any of the seven), counted before the quality rule and before the type screen
rules.scored_months: January–October 2026 months with at least 20 matched days; not testable below 6
rules.pass_mark: primary bridge only: WAPE <= 0.1 and every scored month with at least 300 S-NPP detections within 20% of observed
rules.bridge: M1 (hz.fit(..., 'M1', src='NOAA20')) on Punjab's complete months of 2018-04 to 2025-12 (p01.DEPLOY_BRIDGE), refitted without the type screen for months with no type field; nothing refitted on 2026
rules.regions: Pakistan, Sindh and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: each on its own fit, reported, not tested
